safety: 1. In order to avoid criminals posing as students, make arrangements to meet on the campus grounds.
This way, if someone doesn't know where the meeting location is they can use the navigator to find it.
Remember, the campus grounds are not 100% safe so make sure that the meeting takes place during the day.
2. Don't send the money to the seller before you can confirm that the buyer has the book in their possesion
and they can make the exchange immediately after paying them. Likewise, don't hand over your book without confirming that you will be paid for it.
3. If you decide to meet outside of the capmus grounds, do so at your own risk. Nuclear Software (Pty) Ltd will not be held
responsible if anything bad happens to you.
4. Make the meeting arrangements on the Qampus chat system, this is to ensure that you don't recklessy give away yor personal information.
5. Make sure that the person you arrange to meet with has a profile picture, this way you will know who to expect when making the exchange.
